title: Fixed-array length-header load
summary: Executes a pointer-local load of an array length into a valid internal local, preserving the complete store and an arbitrary continuation.
premises: Equality with the emitted four-instruction header-load region
An empty operand stack and a getter for the pointer local
The exact memory read at the wrapped 32-bit pointer
Eight available bytes at that wrapped address
A continuation from the result-local assignment frame
result: The exact header word reaches the destination local while the complete store and other getters remain unchanged.
